_doc: Planted-regression calendar: scheduled, reversible faults with known start and end, so Morse's Verify, brief ranking and spend outliers can be graded against ground truth. Read by scripts/drive.py (applies each due event to that app's calls only, by header; the window end is the revert) and scripts/morse_review.py (grades whether Morse surfaced each event, and raised nothing on apps with none). Times are UTC. Add events, never rewrite applied ones; the driver image carries this file, so rebuild it after an edit (driver/cloudbuild.yaml). Check: python3 scripts/regressions.py

boosts.why: ranker thresholds: >=150 baseline and >=30 runs in the 24h event window; ~$0.0004/run, so 4x volume costs cents
spend outlier needs >=50 runs; Gemini flash-lite ~$0.002/run

events.note: Pilot, driven by hand (local scripts/drive.py) to prove apply -> drive -> revert; end moved from 14:55 to 13:15 while it ran (three rounds were enough; no scheduled run carried it). Below the ranker thresholds by design: Verify only.
Listings search returns nothing; the answer has no sources, so the developer-tier check fails every turn.

Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite -> Flash. List prices are ~3x input and ~6x output (assumed, not measured). Window moved up on 2026-11-08 (drill compression, founder); re-registered publicly in calendar/2026-11-08-planted-events.json before the window opened. R5 stays clear of R2 (same app, sequential).

Every tool result the model reads is a 503 error. At current volume (~20 runs/day) this is below the 24h ranker thresholds: Verify and the brief only.
